Dedicated junior hardware engineer with strong foundation in circuit design and embedded systems. Proven ability to use simulation tools and perform PCB layout. Seeking challenging role at leading technology firm.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**
*   Circuit Design
*   PCB Layout
*   Embedded Systems
*   Verilog HDL
*   Multisim
*   Altium Designer
*   Soldering
*   Prototyping

*   Implemented microcontroller interface using SPI protocol
*   Created schematic diagrams for power management unit
*   Tested prototype units under various environmental conditions
*   Reduced power consumption by fifteen percent through optimization

**PCB Layout and Assembly**
*   Laid out high density interconnect boards using Altium Designer
*   Performed DFM analysis to ensure manufacturability
*   Soldered components on custom printed circuit boards
*   Conducted thermal imaging to identify hot spots
*   Documented assembly procedures for future reference

**EDUCATION**

**Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering**
University of Technology
Graduated: May 2023
*   Relevant Coursework: Digital Logic Design Analog Circuits Microprocessors
